## The problem

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way?

## Proposed solution

What should DotOS do? For visual changes, describe the look in words or with your own sketch. Do not paste screenshots or artwork from other launchers or operating systems, and do not request copies of Nothing's wallpapers, icons or fonts.

## Alternatives considered

## Constraints check

- [ ] Works fully offline: no `INTERNET`, no analytics, no accounts
- [ ] Needs no new permission (or the permission is optional and requested on first use). If it needs one, which?
- [ ] Possible for a third-party launcher (lock-screen customisation and system UI restyling are out of scope)

## Willing to help?

- [ ] I can try to implement this and open a pull request
